description: This PHP source file defines the ReviewKpiAPI class within the OrangeHRM Performance API module. It provides an endpoint to list KPIs related to a specific performance review, including handling request parameters, validation, and returning collections of KPI summaries. The class utilizes traits for review services and user role management, and follows RESTful API practices with annotations for OpenAPI documentation.
